summary: The team is navigating a mix of operational IT issues and strategic marketing initiatives, with a strong focus on advancing the knowledge website redesign and prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for SEO and marketing.
summaryDetail: The most pressing issue this week is the Outlook account lockout affecting the team, requiring immediate action to delete and re-add accounts across devices and coordinate with JSB for backend unlock. Meanwhile, the knowledge website redesign is in active feedback iteration, with decisions to remove the videos panel, integrate videos into topic sections, and feature indices like BCI on the homepage. Marketing priorities are firmly set on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with SEO efforts underway to boost visibility for AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing topics; a draft of target areas is due from Joseph. Upcoming deliverables include the CKGSB-IE report feedback from Ira, the brand video revision, and the Indonesian SEM contract. The team is also balancing partnership shifts, with US partnerships on hold but Berkeley potentially emerging as a third priority.
